decision_scope: The frozen candidate is acceptable as an exploratory, evidence-linked reading route and provisional seminal-candidate discovery study within the declared 951-record selection. This does not accept definitive seminalness, historical priority, a complete literature census, source completeness, or human scholarly consensus.

independence.allowed_evidence: Exact public scientific files supplied by coordinator and listed in the frozen manifest; original scientific inputs listed by input-manifest.json; installed scientific contracts; own independent checks.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Identity and scope of reviewed candidate
executed_checks.method: Independent SHA256 and byte-size recomputation for all 59 final candidate-4 scientific packet files and all eight original inputs; separately hash manifest/report. Prior candidate-1 and candidate-3 review/check results retained separately.
executed_checks.limit: Hash integrity does not verify source truth or scientific interpretation. No production database write or project publication was reviewed.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Population, citation proxy and coverage denominators
executed_checks.method: Read raw records independently; canonical exact-ID set construction; distinct valid references per source; exclude exact source-target selflinks; recompute all incoming counts and coverage strata.
executed_checks.result: 951 distinct records; 325 nonempty observed reference lists; 10373 distinct source-reference incidences; 725 within-selection incidences including five selflinks; 720 other-work incidences; 168 positive incoming targets; zero disagreements with work-metrics local_incoming. Provider article/review universe is 648, of which 243 have observed references. Era counts in candidate are correctly labeled for this 648 universe.
executed_checks.limit: No evidence that the 626 empty observed lists are complete bibliographies. Incoming values are observed lower-bound counts under exact identities, not complete influence measures. Author self-citations are retained.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Fit between seminal-candidate question and selected methods
executed_checks.method: Compare protocol v3, report and technical specification with installed workflow/R7/R1 contracts and method-source brief.
executed_checks.result: Complementary citation uptake, content and historical evidence support candidate discovery. Coupling is explicitly limited to shared-bibliography discovery/context; no PageRank-only or coupling-only seminalness rule is used. Cited-reference frequency is a separate contextual register and is not called a co-citation map. Deterministic ranks require no optimizer-seed test; absence of inferential claims makes significance/null testing not applicable to this design.
executed_checks.limit: This is a judgment of design fit, not an independently validated seminal-paper classifier. No historic priority or corpus robustness result is established.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Article shortlist eligibility, construct distinctions and bounded appraisal
executed_checks.method: Inspect ten shortlisted IDs and 45 public scientific appraisal decisions; compare with frozen abstract evidence and coordinator's primary-source appraisal memo; inspect explicit contrary/insufficient examples and wider-discovery coverage.
executed_checks.result: All ten priorities are within the original selection. Yukl/Mahsud and DeRue are presented as broad starting points, with distinct concepts. Glover Part One and team/clinical/academic/collaborative branches are bounded and not treated as independent universal origins. The misclassified Practice book and suspected reviews are excluded from the article priorities and preserved contextually. Missing abstracts, content-date anomaly W7104025521 and the flocking false friend are not used as historical support. The 19 unappraised wider candidates remain unassessed rather than rejected.
executed_checks.limit: Independent reviewer read frozen abstracts where present and scope-limited appraisals. The primary-source memo is evidence of coordinator-reported retrieval, not fresh independent full-text verification. No semantic completeness claim for all 951 articles or all 64 wider discovery candidates.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Citation, age, edition and missingness interpretation
executed_checks.method: Inspect report, protocol, contextual register, metadata receipts, sensitivity artifacts and exact-ID rules.
executed_checks.result: Global frozen provider citations, observed local incoming citations, coupling neighbors/strength and reference occurrence counts are separated. Heterogeneous update dates and coarse-cohort denominators are explicit. Citations divided by a 2026 age denominator are not called exposure-adjusted rates or field normalization. Heifetz title/edition records are not merged or citation-pooled. Zero observed incoming is not absence of influence. Reference ablations are reported as construction dependence, not significance or validation of a superior map.
executed_checks.limit: I did not independently rerun weighted coupling reconstruction; that numerical claim needs the distinct statistics/reproducibility review. Complete publication-type/edition audit remains unassessed.

executed_checks.claim_scope: Access scope and scientific assurance wording
executed_checks.method: Inspect report and primary-source memo; attempt independent retrieval of DeRue publisher page and APA issue page.
executed_checks.result: Report distinguishes abstracts/previews/excerpts and failed primary retrievals, avoids clinical causal-effect claims, and leaves human expert interpretation not_assessed. Independent publisher-page attempts returned 403 and timeout; no content claim is accepted as newly verified through those failed requests.

objections.objection: The reproduction order omits clarify-sensitivity.py, although the frozen report relies on its clarification of the four-metric top20 union versus the full discovery union.
objections.required_resolution: Include clarify-sensitivity.py after assemble.py and before build-report.py in the technical reproduction order. Preserve the reviewed frozen candidate and issue a linked corrected delivery version; confirm the change does not alter numerical/scientific claims.
objections.resolution_checked: Inspected current technical-report.json and pure-data clarify-sensitivity.py. Reproduction order now includes clarify-sensitivity.py immediately after assemble.py. The pure-data script no longer writes Python source. Hash comparison with the prior reviewed candidate confirms HTML and all original numerical/scientific appraisal artifacts unchanged. Full recipe replay is assigned to the separate statistics/reproducibility reviewer and is not claimed as my execution.

material_limit_dispositions.issue: Original external-primary-page budget was not centrally enforced
material_limit_dispositions.disposition: No retrospective claim of budget compliance accepted. Does not invalidate retained descriptive findings, but is a process deviation.
Accept reading route only; no assertion of exhaustive historical candidate coverage or shortlist stability across all wider candidates.

material_limit_dispositions.issue: Insufficient evidence for definitive seminal status
material_limit_dispositions.disposition: Report consistently describes provisional candidates and branch reading priorities; no definitive historical ranking accepted.

Full-text/edition/publication-type verification for all candidate and contextual identities.
Expanded construct-sensitive acquisition beyond the literal title boundary and appraisal of the 19 wider unassessed candidates, if a later study claims broader coverage.
